postings.title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You’ll Be Doing

- 

Editions Strategy & Growth

- 

Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

- 

Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

- 

Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

- 

Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

- 

Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

- 

Occupancy & Commercial Performance

- 

Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

- 

Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

- 

Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

- 

Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

- 

P&L Ownership & Governance

- 

Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

- 

Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

- 

Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

- 

Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

- 

Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

- 

Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

- 

Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

- 

Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

- 

Senior Stakeholder Management

- 

Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

- 

Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

- 

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

- 

Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

What You’ll Need to Thrive

- 

7+ years working in commercially focused roles

- 

Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

- 

Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

- 

Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

- 

Mix of both strategy and execution experience

- 

Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

- 

Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

- 

Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

- 

Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

- 

Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

- 

You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

- 

Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

- 

Fluent in French and English is required

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

United Kingdom & Ireland (UK&I) is the largest market for Deliveroo and is at the forefront of strategic, commercial and operational innovation. Our partner-facing commercial teams present one of the biggest growth opportunities available to Deliveroo and we are building a team of commercially savvy, entrepreneurial and ambitious individuals to help us fulfil our partners potential in key categories.

We are looking for a Client Partner to join our UKI Commercial team in the Chinese Category. Reporting to the Head of Chinese Category, this is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Chinese restaurants across UKI.

You will manage a team of Commercial Account Managers who manage and sign the highest performing Chinese restaurants around the UK and Ireland.This position will focus on the regions outside of London. The role will be commercially focused and require cross-functional collaboration with different teams across the Deliveroo business (e.g. Regional Managers, Sales, Finance and Marketing) to ensure the Chinese Category is performing to its best.

What you'll be doing

- Category Leadership: working not just with your direct team, but with regional commercial teams across UK & Ireland, technology, marketing and partnerships to maximise and grow the Category.

- Line management: managing a direct team of Chinese commercial account managers based in our key strategic regional locations.

- Portfolio management: you’ll own the relationship with some of our biggest partners, helping them grow their business, in order to grow ours. 

- Commercial Acumen: lead your commercial team to negotiate effectively with restaurants to achieve the best outcomes for Deliveroo and grow the partners business.

- Role Model: A leader within the team, you will be responsible for driving up sales and commercial performance across the Category including role modelling best-in-class behaviours, managing commercial managers supporting them to hit team targets and grow their portfolios.

- Delivering programmes: as a leader in our business, you’ll lead the delivery and performance of large commercial programmes by working across regional, commercial and project teams based in and out of Head Office.

- Tasting: Sample food from a variety of high quality establishments and attend restaurant and food meet ups. Enjoy the restaurant scene and have a passion for all the different aspects of Chinese cuisine.

Requirements

- 5+ sales and commercial experience in a similar market and industry.

- A strong leader, able to influence colleagues both inside and outside of our organisation in order to achieve our business goals.

- Capable of managing cross functional initiatives to improve ways of working and commercial outcomes.

- Fluent Mandarin speaker. This is a real must as most of our Chinese partners prefer to communicate in Mandarin.

- Experienced manager, managing a direct team of commercial managers and ensuring that they hit targets by supporting their clients' performance.

- Strong negotiator, able to structure win-win deals for restaurants and for Deliveroo

- Have an interest in all things food and restaurants.

postings.title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.

Descriptif du poste :

En tant qu’Apprenti(e) dans l’équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l’équipe média, l’équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu’avec l’équipe commerciale. 

Vos missions consisteront à:

- Mettre en avant sur l’application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l’app.

- Soutenir l’équipe commerciale dans la création et l’exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo. 

- Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).

- Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.

- Contribuer à l’exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l’application / notifications push...).

- Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. 

- Analyser l’impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales

Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. 

Ce qui vous permettra de réussir

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.

Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants

- Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais

- Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.

- Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.

- Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.

- Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.

Voici un lien avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !

La vie chez Deliveroo :

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

postings.title: Associate, Strategy & Operations, New Value Prop & Benefits
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the team

The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. We sit within the wider Subscription EMEA org, whose vision is to create the world's leading membership programme in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world-class experience to members.

The role

We're looking for an Associarte, Strategy & Operations Manager to own strategy and execution for new benefits within Subscription. This is a hybrid strategy/build/run role: you'll define what to launch, then work cross-functionally to get it shipped and measure whether it's working. You'll be expected to move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution — this is not a role where strategy stops at a slide deck.

Typical problems you'll own:

- What new benefits should we launch for Subscription — which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each?

- How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity?

- How do we define success for a new benefit before launch — what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it?

- Once live, how is a benefit actually performing — impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction — against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next?

- How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work?

What you'll do

- Own the strategy and roadmap for new benefits within Subscription — build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution.

- Cross-functional delivery — partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to take benefit ideas from concept to launch, without formal authority over any of them.

- Build and prioritise the benefit pipeline — evaluate a stream of ideas (experiential, use-case specific, or otherwise), size their potential impact and cost, and decide what's worth building next.

- Track ongoing performance — maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention.

- Scale what works — take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably.

- Bring outside-in perspective — track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context.

- Communicate to senior stakeholders — write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership.

What we're looking for

- 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, strategy consulting, or business operations — ideally with exposure to marketplaces, subscription/membership businesses, or consumer tech.

- Commercial acumen: strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and subscriber value; comfortable building a business case and owning a set of P&L-adjacent metrics.

- Analytical rigor: comfortable interpreting data and experiment results to make a clear business call — you'll partner with Data Science on the "how" and "so what."

- Bias for action and ownership: able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems ("what should we build, and how will we know it worked?"), and to drive execution personally rather than just recommend.

- Cross-functional influence: track record of aligning senior stakeholders and diverse functions (Product, Eng, Finance, Marketing) around a shared plan in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

- Excellent written and verbal communication — able to distill complex trade-offs into a clear recommendation for leadership.

Nice to have

- Multi-market experience across EMEA

- Background in a subscription, loyalty, or membership business (delivery, e-commerce, fintech, or otherwise).

Benefits (Deliveroo standard — adjust per market)

- Funded private healthcare (core plan), with option to add family

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

The Team

The Business Development team is the backbone of Deliveroo, tasked with signing up the best restaurants in the UAE to work with us. As a Business Development Manager, you’ll be responsible for signing up and helping to onboard the city’s best restaurants and chains.

You'll be reporting to the Team Lead of your respective city.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- 

Restaurant acquisition: You'll be prospecting, pitching, and closing new restaurants in your territory. This is mostly an inside (telesales) sales opportunity.

- 

Oversee your pipeline: Take control of your own pipeline and use your organisational skills to manage your portfolio of leads and ensure strong conversion rates.

- 

Oversee the partner onboarding process to ensure it is as quick, efficient, and seamless as possible

- 

Ensure partner success within the first weeks from signing

- 

Commercial Projects: Assist our wider commercial team with ad-hoc projects like field pitch days, restaurant marketing roll-outs, and cross-functional projects.

KPIs

- 

Number of partners signed each month from the target list

- 

Performance of partners signed (first 3 months)

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

- 

BSc/BA in business or a related field

- 

Minimum of 2 years of sales experience

- 

Knowledge of the restaurant landscape in the UAE

- 

Demonstrable sales track record with experience in prospecting, pitching, and closing deals

- 

Experienced negotiator and able to structure win-win deals for partners and for Deliveroo

- 

Commercially knowledgeable person who understands the economics of delivery - for restaurant partners and Deliveroo

- 

Be able to maturely demonstrate product and industry knowledge to clients

- 

Take ownership and work towards demanding targets

- 

A fantastic communicator with a "get it done" mindset, well organised and efficient

- 

Fluency in English; Hindi or Arabic is a plus

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

postings.description:

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About Deliveroo:

Deliveroo is an award-winning online food delivery company on a mission to bring the world's best-loved local restaurants directly to people's doors. With a network of high-quality restaurants, riders, and customers, we're making fast food delivery a seamless experience worldwide. We are a rapidly growing company with a huge ambition, and we're always looking for top talent to join us.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Dutch speaking, highly motivated and results-oriented Business Development Associate to join our expanding team in Belgium. In this role, you will be instrumental in driving Deliveroo's growth by proactively identifying, engaging, and onboarding new restaurant and food business partners (including supermarkets, butchers, bakeries, etc.) onto the Deliveroo platform. Your primary focus will be on building strong relationships with potential partners and showcasing the value proposition of partnering with Deliveroo in Antwerp, Bruges and Ghent.

Responsibilities:

• Actively identify and prospect potential restaurant and food business partners within your assigned territory.

• Conduct outreach (via phone, email, and in-person meetings) to introduce Deliveroo and its benefits to prospective partners.

• Present Deliveroo's value proposition clearly and persuasively, addressing the specific needs and concerns of each business.

• Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to successful onboarding of new partners.

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified leads.

• Negotiate partnership terms and agreements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

• Collaborate closely with internal teams (e.g., Onboarding, Account Management) to ensure a smooth and successful launch for new partners.

• Stay up-to-date on market trends, competitor activities, and the local food and beverage landscape.

• Meet and exceed targets for new partner acquisition.

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and progress within CRM systems.

Requirements:

• Native Dutch speaker is essential.

• Fluency in English is required.

• Proficiency in French is a strong plus, but not essential.

• Proven sales experience is a significant advantage.

• A genuine passion for food and the restaurant/grocery industry.

• Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and target-driven with a strong work ethic.

• Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Valid driver's license and willingness to travel locally as needed.

What We Offer:

• The opportunity to work for a fast-growing and exciting global company.

• A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

• Competitive salary and benefits package (including car allowance).

• Opportunities for professional development and growth.

• The chance to make a real impact on Deliveroo's success in Belgium.

postings.title: Business Development Manager - Grocery & Retail
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Manager – New Vertical based in Rome.

As a BDM, you will play a key role in expanding Deliveroo's New Vertical business by identifying, acquiring, and launching new retail partners across your territory. You will own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and relationship building to negotiation and contract signing — helping to grow Deliveroo's presence in your local market.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales, Account Management, Operations, Marketing, and the Onboarding team to ensure partners are successfully activated and positioned for long-term success. This is a highly entrepreneurial role, requiring strong commercial acumen, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a passion for building new business opportunities.

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to grow partner selection, increase market coverage, and contribute to the overall growth of Deliveroo's business.

What You'll Be Doing

- Identify, prospect, and acquire new Grocery partners within your assigned territory, with a focus on independent retailers and local chains.

- Own the full sales cycle, from lead generation and initial outreach to negotiation, contract signing, and launch.

- Build strong relationships with business owners and key decision-makers, becoming a trusted partner and advisor.

- Collaborate with Onboarding, Operations, Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure smooth partner activation and successful launches.

- Track and manage your sales pipeline, ensuring consistent delivery against acquisition and growth targets

- Act as a local ambassador for Deliveroo, strengthening brand presence and credibility within the retail community

Our humble expectations

- Strong drive and enthusiasm for sales and business development — you are comfortable reaching out to new contacts and building relationships from scratch.

- Confidence in dealing with partners and customers across all channels: in person mainly, by phone

- Excellent communication and negotiation skills — you can explain complex value propositions clearly and handle objections with empathy and conviction.

- A genuine curiosity about the Italian food and grocery market — knowledge of the local independent retail landscape is a significant plus.

- Organised and self-directed: you are comfortable managing your own pipeline and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

- Fluency in Italian and a good command of English

Nice to have

- Being familiar with Salesforce

- Have experience with the food industry

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo, we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific. Please ask your recruiter for more information.

Compensation

- National Collective Agreement (CBA): CCNL Commercio e Terziario

- Classification Level: Livello 4

The total target compensation (OTE: On-Target Earnings) for this role is €35,200 – €44,000 gross per year, of which the base salary range is €17,200 – €26,000 The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed above and is determined based on a number of job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.

postings.title: Business Development Manager - Strasbourg (CDD 6 mois)
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.
Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Business Development Manager basé(e) à Strasbourg (CDD), vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l’expansion de Deliveroo en France. Rattaché(e) au Regional Sales Manager, vous rejoindrez une équipe ambitieuse et déterminée à accélérer notre croissance.

Vos principales responsabilités seront:

- Prospecter et signer de nouveaux restaurateurs partenaires (téléphone & terrain).

- Générer un volume d’appels quotidiens pour alimenter votre pipeline commercial.

- Être présent sur le terrain au moins 3 jours par semaine pour développer votre zone.

- Présenter et vendre l’offre Deliveroo en s’appuyant sur le script de vente interne et en adaptant votre discours à chaque interlocuteur.

- Piloter les négociations commerciales de bout en bout et conclure efficacement les ventes.

- Atteindre vos objectifs mensuels et assurer un suivi rigoureux dans le CRM.

- Accompagner les partenaires après signature et reporter régulièrement votre activité a votre manager.

Profil recherché:

- Bac+3 minimum ou expérience équivalente en vente.

- Expérience confirmée en commerce, idéalement en B2B.

- À l’aise avec la prospection terrain et le contact commerçant.

- Excellent relationnel, sens de la négociation et du closing.

- Autonome, organisé(e) et orienté(e) résultats.

- Appétence pour l’univers de la restauration et de la foodtech.

- Permis B obligatoire.

Ce que nous offrons :

- Un salaire fixe attractif avec des commissions déplafonnées sur les ventes réalisées.

- De réelles perspectives d'évolution au sein de l’équipe commerciale et plus largement dans l'entreprise.

- Un environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif, au cœur d’une entreprise en pleine croissance.

- Télétravail hybride pour un meilleur équilibre entre autonomie et esprit d’équipe.

- Une politique avantageuse pour les parents.

- Un accès à WellPass à tarif préférentiel pour entretenir votre bien-être.

- Les frais de livraison offerts sur Deliveroo+ pour profiter de nos meilleures offres.

Si vous êtes motivé(e), persévérant(e) et prêt(e) à relever de nouveaux défis au sein d’une équipe de vente dynamique et ambitieuse, postulez dès maintenant et participez à la croissance de Deliveroo !

Environnement de travail & avantages

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.

Diversité

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!
À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Diagnose complex configuration, data and integration problems, escalating to Tier 3 or Workday support where needed.

- Three or more years of hands-on Workday configuration experience in Time Tracking and/or Absence Management; Core HCM experience is a plus.

- Experience gathering requirements, writing functional specifications and translating them into configuration.

- Experience designing and executing test scripts, coordinating UAT and completing regression testing.

postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Team

The Business Operations & Strategy (BOS) team sits within the Italian commercial organisation. It gives the commercial teams their direction through targets, instructions, processes and tools, keeps the operating pace, and runs the operations that deliver our business objectives. As Commercial Strategy Manager you connect strategy to execution at country level: you help shape how the commercial organisation deploys its people and its investment, you steer the country's strategic programmes, and you make sure global frameworks become local ways of working. You report to the Head of BOS, who is part of the local commercial leadership team.

This is a role for someone who sees what is missing and builds it, without waiting to be asked.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Shape country and regional strategy. Help define where Italy invests, where it defends and where it monetises, by turning market and performance data into a clear view of priorities across regions and cities. 

- Equip Regional Managers to plan. Regional Managers own their City and Regional Plans. You give them a shared framework of analysis and a common method, so plans are built on the same logic and can be compared and consolidated into the country view. You support them as they draft, test their assumptions, and turn what works into repeatable local playbooks that any region can apply.

- Drive strategic programmes across regions. Own cross-region strategic programmes from intent to delivery, using the same frameworks and methods. You provide that structure and keep it running through governance, risk management and regular steering.

- Connect central and local. You adapt them to local conditions and field reality, act as the day-to-day contact for central teams, and bring local learning back to central.

- Plan the organisation and the sales force. Support the design of the commercial organisation and the planning of its capacity: how the team is structured, how coverage and capacity are sized against the opportunity, how targets are allocated, and how hiring and ramp-up are phased.

- Plan commercial investment. Support the planning of the investment budget: how resources are allocated across areas and initiatives, which trade-offs are accepted, and how return is measured and reviewed over time. You build the business case that links an investment to its expected impact.

- Analyse and track. Own the analysis and tracking that sit behind these decisions: define the right measures, establish baselines, and turn data into clear recommendations. Use AI to work faster, and verify what it produces before anyone relies on it.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

- 4-7 years of experience in commercial environments (account management, sales, sales operations or commercial strategy), ideally in a marketplace, delivery or fast-growing B2B business. You know how the field really works, and you have moved, or want to move, into strategy.

- A track record of running cross-functional programmes without formal authority, and of solving comparable problems in commercial planning: prioritising where to focus, sizing capacity, or allocating budget against objectives.

- Experience building or supporting commercial plans (market, regional or territory plans) and giving other people a method to follow: a framework or playbook that teams actually adopted.

- Structured problem solving: you break problems into drivers, go several layers deep on the "why", look for evidence that could prove you wrong, and can state the so-what in one sentence.

- Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel or Google Sheets, working SQL, and experience with BI dashboards. You are comfortable using AI tools and you verify their output.

- Clear written and spoken communication in Italian and English, from a field team huddle to a leadership readout.

- Nice to have: experience designing a framework that other teams or markets adopted; exposure to organisation design, sales force planning, budget planning or incentive design.

- You go to the lowest level of detail and keep the big picture in view. You act quickly and correct course. You seek the truth in the data, even when it contradicts the plan. You adapt global standards when local needs require it, and you commit fully once a decision is made.

postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Team

DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last-mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying autonomous aviation technologies in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!

About the Role

As the Drone Operations Manager for UK & Ireland, you are a player-coach who will stand up our drone delivery operation in the region from nothing. You will personally fly on a regular basis, as a working pilot, while you build the team, find and fit out the operating sites, and help take us through UK CAA and/or Irish Aviation Authority (IAA)/EASA authorisation. You will contribute to the manuals you fly under.

As we build out the team in 2027, the future Chief Pilot (or equivalent nominated post-holder) and Head of Maintenance will report to you. You will work day to day with engineering and product, in person, at the launch site. This role is on-site and cannot be done remotely.

What You'll Do Day to Day

Fly and Operate (a regular part of the job, not occasional):

- Fly as a pilot in command on a regular rota: aircraft acceptance and commissioning flights, proving flights for the regulator, and live delivery operations.

- Run pre-flight and post-flight checks, site and airspace checks, weather go/no-go decisions, battery and payload handling, and flight logging in line with the Operations Manual.

- Act as visual observer, payload operator or flight supervisor as needed, and be on the ground at launch and landing sites during operations.

- Keep your own pilot competency, currency, recurrent training and flight records up to date, to the standard you set for the team.

- Lead incident, accident and occurrence response in the field and file regulator reports (CAA mandatory occurrence reporting / IAA-EASA equivalent) and run the follow-up investigation.

Build the Team:

- Recruit, hire and onboard the first pilots, ops technicians, visual observers, maintenance staff and the nominated safety/compliance post-holders.

- Write the training syllabus and run initial and recurrent training, including practical flight checks, competency assessments, emergency drills and currency tracking.

- Build the duty roster, flight-time and fatigue limits, and on-call coverage.

Find and Build the Sites:

- Scout and secure launch/landing sites, hubs and maintenance space near merchant partners. Walk the sites, survey obstacles, flight paths, ground risk and operational suitability, and negotiate access, leases and landowner permissions.

- Oversee on-site fit-out: workshop space, battery charging and storage (including fire protection and lithium battery storage rules), power and connectivity, security, landing pads, signage, first aid and fire equipment.

- Support planning consent and local authority approvals. Own risk assessments, health and safety procedures, and set up all site requirements with support from corporate teams as needed.

- Own the launch plan, budget, vendors and timeline for each site. 

- Lead local community and stakeholder engagement for each site (neighbours, local authorities), including noise and privacy concerns.

- Work with the aircraft provider and engineering on site layout, charging, battery swap and loading equipment.

Regulatory Authorisation and Compliance:

- Run the Safety Management System (SMS): hazard reporting, risk assessments, safety reviews, audits and corrective actions.

- Stay compliant with UK GDPR/EU GDPR (ICO or Data Protection Commission), insurance (Regulation 785/2004 and UK equivalent), noise, and local environmental requirements.

- Be the day-to-day contact for the CAA, IAA and air navigation service providers, including audits, inspections and flight demonstrations.

Scale the Operation:

- Track flight, delivery and reliability metrics and use them to improve procedures, rotas and site layouts.

- Work with the commercial operations lead to match merchant demand to flight capacity.

- Work with the US drone operations team to adapt proven processes to the UK/Ireland regulatory environment.

Why You'll Love This Role

- Keep flying: you will be hands-on with aircraft every week while you lead.

- Be at the forefront of autonomous aviation and shape last-mile drone delivery in the EMEA.

- Build a team, a site and an operation from the ground up with autonomy and trust.

- Work directly with engineers who build the aircraft and software you operate.

What We're Looking For

- Current remote pilot qualifications and significant hands-on UAS flight experience (including BVLOS or complex operations), with a CAA or EASA-recognised pilot competency (e.g. A2 CofC, GVC/OSC-level, or national equivalent).

- Experience holding or managing UK CAA Operational Authorisations and/or EASA Specific category authorisations (or LUC).

- Proven ability to write and enforce SOPs, checklists and Operations Manuals.

- Working knowledge of UK CAA / IAA / EASA regulations, SORA, airspace and compliance frameworks.

- Experience leading and training pilots, and starting up or scaling flight operations.

- Practical experience setting up an operating site: finding space, working with landlords, contractors and local authorities, and handling battery storage and site safety.

- Background in risk assessment, SMS, and emergency response.

- Willingness to work in the field in all weather, including early mornings, evenings and weekends, as operations require.

Bonus Qualifications

- Commercial drone delivery or logistics experience.

- Prior involvement in obtaining BVLOS authorisations in the UK or EU.

- Technical understanding of autonomous flight systems, aircraft maintenance and aviation software.

- Existing relationships with the UK CAA, IAA, NATS or AirNav Ireland.

postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Team

We're building drone delivery for the long term. We already operate certified drone programmes in the US, and we’re now taking that to Europe and the Middle East, working closely with Deliveroo’s operations, policy and go-to-market teams. If you want to help decide how autonomous aviation gets approved and scaled in new markets, we want to talk to you.

About the Role

As the EMEA Regulatory Lead, you will be the face of drone delivery to aviation regulators in the UK, the EU and the Middle East. Regulation here is built on relationships and trust as much as paperwork, and you’ll be the person who builds both. You’ll set the regulatory strategy, steer a specialist consultant team through permits and operational approvals, and shape how a new category of aircraft operation is approved in major markets.

This is a new role. Consultants are already working on approvals to fly. You’ll take over those relationships and that workstream, and build the in-region regulatory function from the ground up. You’ll report to DoorDash's Drones Regulatory and Policy Lead in the US, and work alongside the operations team based at Deliveroo’s London office.

What You’ll Do Day to Day

Own the Regulator Relationships:

- Be the primary point of contact for the UK CAA, the Irish Aviation Authority, EASA and national authorities, and other regulators.

- Meet regulators directly to explain our concept of operations, technology and safety case, and build the trust needed to unlock new markets and capabilities.

- Advocate for policy changes that address authorities’ concerns while enabling scalable, risk-proportionate deployment beyond trials and demonstrations.

Drive Approvals:

- Own SORA-style application packages end to end, pulling technical, safety and operational input from engineering, product, safety and operations into complete submissions, and driving them through approval.

- Manage the consultants who do the groundwork on permits and operational approvals, including scope, timelines and quality.

- Help sequence target markets and capabilities based on regulatory feasibility, timeline and risk, so expansion decisions rest on regulatory reality. 

- Support the permit push once the launch aircraft is confirmed.

Shape Strategy and Policy:

- Partner with DoorDash leadership on international deployment strategy for the EU, UK and Middle East.

- Align with our US-based UAS Regulatory & Policy Lead to share playbooks and precedents and keep our position consistent on cross-border issues such as standards and cross-recognition of approvals.

- Act as the link between DoorDash Air and Deliveroo’s policy and go-to-market teams, so aviation positions fit with Deliveroo’s wider European government affairs work.

- Track legislative, regulatory and industry developments in UAS, U-Space and UTM, and turn them into clear recommendations for leadership.

Represent Us Externally:

- Speak for the company at European and Middle Eastern conferences and industry forums. Travel is occasional, mainly regional events and regulator meetings.

- Engage with UAS and UTM advocacy and standards bodies (for example JARUS) so our operational and technical needs are reflected in emerging frameworks.

Build the Function:

- Set up the processes, governance and relationships that let us run regulatory work across the region, and shape what the team looks like as we grow.

What We’re Looking For

- A traditional aviation background, either as a pilot or aviator or as a regulator, with a solid understanding of the drone and unmanned aircraft industry and its key issues.

- 10+ years in aviation regulatory affairs, government affairs or public policy, with current depth in UAS regulation. This is a mid-senior role that needs subject-matter expertise from day one.

- Working command of JARUS SORA and of the national and European authority processes (UK CAA, IAA, EASA) for UAS and BVLOS approvals.

- Detailed knowledge of how the airspace system works, including how unmanned aircraft are kept clear of crewed and other unmanned aircraft.

- Experience assembling and submitting SORA-style packages, or assessing them from the regulator side.

- The gravitas and communication skills to represent a company to regulators and argue its case, and to turn complex regulatory issues into clear decisions for senior leaders.

- Basic project management skills, with experience managing consultants or external partners.

- Based in, or willing to relocate to, London or elsewhere in Europe.

- Fluent English.

Bonus Qualifications

- Experience as a regulator, or an existing network of regulator relationships across the UK, EU and Middle East.

- Experience in the Middle East or familiarity with the UAE regulatory landscape.

- A second European or regional language (for example French, German or Arabic).

- Experience representing an organisation in UAS or UTM standards bodies and industry conferences.

- Experience in commercial drone delivery or other industry operations.

Head of Merchant Excellence

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Merchant Excellence team sits at the heart of Deliveroo’s marketplace—ensuring our restaurant and retail partners receive world-class support and seamless operational experiences. If you are a seasoned operations leader who thrives in complex, high-stakes environments and enjoys influencing global product and policy, this is the role for you.

We’re looking for a Head of Merchant Excellence to join our Merchant Leadership team. Based in our Manchester office with a hybrid work pattern (3 days in-office), you will be responsible for the strategic direction and performance of a c.80-person global operation across the UK and Italy.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will be the architect of our partner support strategy, moving between high-level executive discussions and granular operational performance management.

- Strategic Architecture: Recommend and own the global strategy for Partner Operations, including site selection and the balance between in-house and outsourced (BPO) solutions.

- Product & Tech Influence: Partner with Product and Technology teams to shape the future roadmap.

- You will provide the "voice of the merchant," identifying agent pain points and advocating for self-service vs. agent-led channel strategies.

- Operational Leadership: Set and achieve department-level targets for a team of c.80 colleagues.

- You will design the frameworks that ensure functional managers and vendors are held accountable to world-class KPIs.

- Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted advisor to the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and C-suite. You will lead deep dives into operational issues and present clear, data-driven solutions to complex problems.

- Culture & People Development: Foster a high-performance culture inclusive of experimentation and continuous learning.

- You will manage performance, drive employee satisfaction initiatives (Peakon), and mentor the next generation of Deliveroo leaders.

- Relentless Improvement: Surface operational friction and influence stakeholders across Product, Legal, and Finance to address root causes.

- On-Call Support: Participate in a 24/7 on-call rota for approximately 2 weeks per quarter to ensure our marketplace remains resilient.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate is a "detailed and action-oriented" leader with a heavy background in scaling complex operations:

- Scale Experience: Significant leadership experience in a large-scale, international contact centre or operational environment.

- Strategic Influence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build trust with local market senior management and global Exec stakeholders.

- Operational Rigor: A proven track record of building and scaling customer care organisations in fast-paced, consumer-facing tech businesses.

- Technical Savvy: Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and solid analytical skills (Excel pivot tables, INDEX MATCH). SQL skills are a major plus.

- People Management: Experience managing "managers of managers," implementing performance initiatives, and driving engagement across multi-site setups.

- Communication: Ability to write concise project documents that bridge the gap between technical operations and executive strategy.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll solve some of the most interesting questions in the tech-logistics space. Working here you can expect to:

🚀 Make a Visible Impact: Your strategy directly affects the success of thousands of merchants across the globe.

🌱 Fast-Track Progression: As a member of the Merchant Leadership team, you are at the forefront of the company’s strategic growth.

🧠 Autonomy and Ownership: We move fast and empower our leaders to take accountability for their own departments.

postings.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

- Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.

- Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.

- Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.

- Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.

- Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.

- Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.

- Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

- 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.

- 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.

- A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.

- Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).

- Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.

- Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

- Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.

- Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.

- Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.

- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).

- Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

- A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.

- Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.

- A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.

- Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.

- An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

postings.description:

About the Role

There’s a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love.

As a Graduate Product Designer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, or Customer Experience & Integrity. You’ll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. 

- You’ll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship.

- You’ll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you’ll quickly grow to own design end-to-end.

- You’ll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders.

- You’ll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human.

- You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won’t just shape your own projects - it’ll shape how design is practiced across the team.

- You’ll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration.

- You’ll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation.

We’re looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here’s what you’ll need to join us and thrive in the role:

- You’re in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027.

- You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals - visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving.

- AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience.

- You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly.

- You’re excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback.

Why Join Us?

Our Finance team shapes the company’s future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We’re looking for a Head of Indirect Tax, EMEA to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. You’ll lead VAT advisory across DoorDash International, covering Deliveroo and Wolt markets, with a particular focus on the UK as one of our largest markets. postings.title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
The Team

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo’s Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

The Role

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo’s Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

Roles & Responsibilities: 

- Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning: Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.

- Drive business performance: Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.

- Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda: Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.

- Lead high-impact strategic initiatives: Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.

- Lead and develop high-performing teams: Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.

- Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions: Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business’s most important strategic priorities.

 Qualifications:

- 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.

- Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.

- Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.

- Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.

- Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.

- Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.

- Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

Benefits and Diversity

- Annual Holiday Leave

- Annual flight allowance 

- Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers

- Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits

- End of year parties & regular social events

- An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. postings.title: Head of New Verticals Marketing, UK and Ireland
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the role

Deliveroo is seeking a commercially driven, strategic and execution-focused Head of New Verticals Marketing to lead the next phase of growth across our grocery and retail businesses in the UK & Ireland. On-demand grocery and retail are among the most exciting parts of our business: customers increasingly want their weekly shop, everyday essentials and gifts delivered quickly, and we help the top grocers and retailers grow to meet these needs. 

You will shape and deliver the UK & Ireland marketing strategy across grocery and retail, managing the marketing budget and driving category positioning, partner growth and campaign excellence, and lead a team to bring it to life. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Commercial, Growth, Product and Analytics, you will act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders and some of the biggest brands in the UK & Ireland, driving measurable commercial impact. 

This is a chance to make your mark with real influence over strategy, partners and investment.

What you'll be doing

Strategy, planning and performance

- Shape and lead the grocery and retail marketing strategy for the UK & Ireland, tied to ambitious growth targets and informed by what customers, categories and performance are telling us.

- Build annual and quarterly plans around the missions and moments that matter to UK & Ireland shoppers, from the weekly shop to key seasonal and trading events.

- Balance brand building and performance marketing to drive sustainable acquisition, retention and frequency, with disciplined, ROI-led investment.

- Own the growth targets and KPIs for grocery and retail, monitor performance and course-correct quickly. Set the measurement framework, lead post-campaign analysis and turn learnings into sharper plans, presenting results to leadership.

- Bring Commercial, Product, Growth and Analytics together to solve cross-functional problems and give structure to new, fast-moving areas.

Category and propositions

- Develop a distinctive, data-led category strategy for grocery and retail, with clear positioning and value propositions that stand out for customers and partners.

- Turn market trends and shopper behaviour into scalable growth plans for partners. 

- Share what works in the UK & Ireland with other markets and tailor global strategy to local needs.

Partners and growth

- Build strong marketing partnerships with leading grocers and retailers, from joint business plans to integrated campaigns, helping them grow on Deliveroo and shaping propositions customers love.

- Own the working partnership with Commercial leadership, supporting the winning and launch of new partners. 

- Drive integrated, creative marketing plans across CRM, social, paid media, PR and in-app that unlock incremental growth, with a high bar for execution.

Leading the team

- Lead and develop a team of five, including two direct reports: set priorities and standards and develop their careers.

- Build efficient ways of working, using automation and AI.

- Foster a culture of innovation, ownership and executional excellence.

Key skills and experience

- Significant senior marketing leadership experience (10+ years), ideally in retail, grocery, marketplace, eCommerce or tech.

- Strong commercial and data fluency with a test-and-learn mindset: turn performance data into plans and defensible trade-offs, make sound investment decisions with incomplete data, and manage substantial budgets with measurable impact.

- Experience building and executing multi-channel marketing strategies across acquisition, retention and brand.

- Stakeholder management and influence, including joint business planning with large strategic partners, negotiating and building consensus across partners and internal teams.

- Experience launching and scaling new propositions, categories or physical locations (e.g. stores).

- Knowledge of the UK & Ireland grocery and retail landscape, and how shoppers behave in it.

- Outstanding organisation and project management with exceptional attention to detail.

- Comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

postings.description:
