The Role:

We are on a mission to revolutionise the retail e-commerce industry. We are a tech-driven company, committed to delivering innovative solutions that redefine the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide. We are at the forefront of something massive, and we're looking for an experienced leader who can help us shape the future of retail e-commerce.

Retail (non-food Shopping) is how Deliveroo and Wolt grow beyond restaurants and grocery. As the Head of Retail, Strategy & Operations, you will lead the direction of Deliveroo and Wolt’s newest vertical. Reporting to the Director of Strategy & Operations, New Verticals EMEA, you will shape our approach across commercial, operations, marketing and customer experience. This role owns the strategy and operating rhythm for the business: where we play, which retailers we need in each market, whether they succeed after launch, and whether revenue and profit are on the plan.

This is an individual contributor (IC) role, meaning you won’t have any direct reports. You will set the agenda that Product, Commercial, Marketing, Operations, and country teams execute, and you will need to work cross-functionally with teams to ensure plans are delivered.

The NV Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the end-to-end strategy and performance management of New Verticals EMEA as a whole, including target-setting, goals and OKRs, and the weekly and monthly business reviews. Within that, this role owns the Retail strategy.

The role is hybrid in London, with 3 days per week in the office and potential for quarterly travel to offices in the US and EMEA as required.

Responsibilities:

- Define our future strategy for Retail, including "where we play" and "how we win" to grow revenue and drive customer acquisition.

- Identify future elements of our customer and partner value proposition and the required capabilities to deliver them in collaboration with the NV tech teams, and lead deployment of these across EMEA.

- Establish a roadmap to becoming the preferred delivery provider for our Retail partners. Develop an understanding of Retail partner needs and advocate for them across teams.

- Ensure detailed implementation plans are developed across markets and teams, with a strong follow-up on execution through robust tracking and issue resolution.

- Lead delivery of revenue growth by identifying partner growth levers for Retail and supporting local teams to deploy them across their partner portfolios.

- Manage the P&L and all financial investments to realise or exceed our annual financial goals. Set annual plans including resource allocation, budgets and market targets for the EMEA portfolio.

- Lead performance management and forecasting routines to ensure in-year delivery and course-correction to meet revenue and profit targets.

- Support negotiations with the largest partners and ensure teams approach all negotiations following our Retail commercial framework regarding rate structure and return on investment.

- Ensure that local teams can build joint business plans with the most important Retail partners. Collaborate with the global Merchant organisation on the partners with an international footprint.

- Create a compelling vision with a sense of unity and a desire to perform together. Provide reporting, best-practice guides, playbooks and training so teams can run the plan effectively.

- Foster collaboration throughout the organisation, understanding the benefit and importance of central / local collaboration.

Leadership Capabilities & Behaviours:

- Performance-focused: A drive to understand what happened, why it happened and what to do next. Owns a recurring operating rhythm with fixed deadlines, holds a high bar for accuracy, and sets escalation routes when goals are off track.

- Structured: Brings structure to recurring processes and complex problems. Manages multiple workstreams across regions and follows actions through to closure.

- Influential and collaborative: Builds trust with stakeholders and functional leads. Challenges assumptions and pushes for clear decisions and owners, even when data is incomplete. Adapts their style to the audience and is a trusted advisor to senior partners and teams.

- Commercial and analytical: Connects customer, operational and financial metrics to explain performance. Understands the trade-offs between growth and profitability.

- Solution finding and strategy: Identifies commercial opportunities and issues in complex situations, and turns them into clear commercial choices.

- Thought-leadership: Uses data and insight from across the market to shape a clear vision for the future that is recognised internally and externally as industry leading.

- Change Management: Role-models a continuous improvement mindset that embraces change and deploys best-practice approaches to win hearts and minds, so changes embed in the organisation.

- Community-Building: A team player who readily collaborates across teams and will sponsor or lead programmes that inspire an engaged, diverse, winning organisation.

Experience & Skills:

- Demonstrated track record in strategy consulting or similar (ideally 4-6 years of experience).

- Experience in grocery, retail or quick commerce is preferred.

- Highly analytical mindset with strong modelling skills, and the ability to break down large data sets and turn them into actionable insights. Comfortable with P&L metrics.

- Experience running performance management processes, such as business reviews, KPI reporting and plan tracking, for senior audiences.

- Strong problem-solving skills, including identifying root causes, assessing risks and impacts, and determining effective solutions.

- Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working with regional and functional teams inside complex, matrixed organisations.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including concise, numbers-led commentary for senior leadership.

Key questions the role supports:

- What is our strategy for growing non-food retail across EMEA?

- How do we win in retail quick commerce, and what is our value proposition?

- Which product features and capabilities do we need to succeed?

- Which hero retailers do we need to onboard in each market?

- How do we make those retailers successful after launch?

- Which consumer missions and moments are we relevant to?

- How are we pacing against the long-term plan, and what is driving performance?

Key interfaces:

- NV EMEA leadership, and other cross-functional senior stakeholders

- NV functional leads (Product, Commercial, Marketing and Operations, at regional and global level)

- US DoorDash Global Retail teams (S&O, Product, Commercial, Finance)

- Regional General Managers (RGMs) and their regional and country commercial teams across Deliveroo & Wolt markets.

postings.title: Merchant Onboarding Specialist (Launcher)
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
We're looking for our first Launcher in the UK. You'll get restaurants live on our restaurant software, from the moment a venue signs to the day its staff use the system with confidence. You'll be our person on the ground in the UK: the link between merchants, sales, product, support and operations.

This is a founding role in a new market. There's no UK playbook yet; you'll take what we've built in Finland and Austria and make it work here. You'll run your own week, own your venues end to end, and be the first contact for anything operational in the UK.

You'll report to the regional operations manager. The role is based flexibly in the Midlands and is largely field-based: expect to travel to merchant sites across the UK most weeks, with more travel during the first months of launch.

What you'll own

- Venue onboarding end to end: sync with sales on new signings, schedule go-lives with venues, get hardware ready, oversee assembly and installation, set up menus, train staff and hand over to support

- Menu setup: build and adjust venue menus and product configuration before and after go-live

- On-site installation: assemble, install and connect various hardware, including ethernet cabling and troubleshooting connectivity

- Venue readiness: check sites before install day, agree network and cabling requirements with the venue, and flag anything that would block a go-live

- Logistics: plan deliveries and move hardware between storage, venues and partners cost-effectively

- 3PL and installation partners: help select, set up and manage UK logistics and installation partners, and hold them to cost and quality

- Merchant support: be the first line of support for newly onboarded venues, and resolve or escalate issues quickly

- Sales collaboration: be the onboarding contact for the UK sales team, plan go-lives together and push back on dates that aren't realistic

- The onboarding playbook: keep improving instructions, training materials and support content so the next person can onboard a venue from day one

- Feedback loop: share what you learn from merchants with product, support and ops, and propose fixes rather than just problems

What we're looking for

- Proven independence: a track record of running your own work without day-to-day direction, such as owning a territory, a launch, a set of clients or a field operation. Be ready to show us examples.

- 3+ years of experience in operations, field operations, onboarding, implementation or project management 

- Comfortable with hands-on tech: setting up devices, tablets, printers and routers, basic networking and cabling, and calmly troubleshooting on site

- Highly organised: you plan ahead, keep accurate records and don't let commitments to merchants or colleagues slip

- Proactive: you spot problems before they happen, ask for help early, and come with a proposed fix

- Strong communicator with merchants and internal teams, including saying no when needed

- Experience in hospitality, restaurant tech, or field installation is a strong plus

- Fluent English; additional languages are a plus

- Full UK driving licence (required). Owning a car is a big plus.

- Willing to travel frequently across the UK and able to carry and install equipment

- Right to work in the UK

What a typical week might look like

- Monday: recap last week and plan this one (venues, deliveries, stock, risks), then sync with sales on the latest signings

- Confirm go-live dates and times with venues and check that hardware and network requirements are in place

- Build and check menus for upcoming go-lives

- Travel between venues: install, train staff and troubleshoot

- Check in with recently launched venues a few days after go-live

- Answer merchant questions and resolve or escalate support issues

- Maintain inventory, flag low stock and coordinate with logistics partners

- Improve the onboarding documentation and share learnings with product and support

What we offer

- A founding role in a new market, with real ownership and room to grow the role

- Independent work in a dynamic, international team

- Employee Assistance Programme: therapy and wellbeing

- Private medical, dental and wellbeing support

- Company pension and life assurance

- Income protection and critical illness cover

- Flexible extras: cycle to work, travel insurance, extra annual leave

- Modern work equipment

- Hybrid working

Next steps

If you're excited about launching a new market, taking ownership and being part of an ambitious team, click below to apply. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will contact you shortly to start the hiring process.

postings.title: Payroll Analyst - International
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About Deliveroo

At Deliveroo, our mission is to build the definitive food company. To make that possible, we’re creating an environment where everyone can belong, grow, and do their best work.

About the Role

As an Italy Payroll Analyst, you will be responsible for administering and overseeing the end-to-end payroll process for our Italy population. You’ll partner closely with HR, Finance, Employment Tax, Legal and our external payroll providers to ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll delivery.

This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical expertise in Italian payroll legislation, statutory compliance and employee taxation. You will act as the Italy Payroll Subject Matter Expert (SME), ensuring robust payroll governance, maintaining high standards of accuracy and supporting continuous improvement across our Workday and CloudPay payroll ecosystem.

You will also play an important role in identifying opportunities to simplify, automate and improve payroll processes, while supporting wider global payroll initiatives and projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Lead the end-to-end Italy payroll process — from data preparation, validation and payroll inputs through to review, reconciliation and final sign-off, ensuring accurate and timely payroll delivery.

- Act as the Italy Payroll SME, providing expert guidance on Italian payroll legislation, taxation, statutory requirements and payroll best practice.

- Support other payroll entities within the team where required, contributing to the successful delivery of the wider global payroll operation.

- Oversee outsourced payroll processing with our payroll provider, CloudPay, ensuring agreed SLAs, controls and quality standards are consistently met.

- Partner cross-functionally with HR, Finance, Employment Tax and Legal to resolve payroll issues, ensure accurate data flows and deliver a seamless employee payroll experience.

- Maintain strong knowledge of Italian payroll legislation and statutory requirements, ensuring payroll processes remain compliant with regulatory changes.

- Ensure the accurate and timely processing of Italian statutory payments, contributions and filings, including social security, income tax and other applicable statutory requirements.

- Review and reconcile payroll outputs, identifying discrepancies and ensuring issues are investigated and resolved before payroll sign-off.

- Prepare and reconcile payroll journals and Finance reporting, ensuring payroll costs are accurately reflected in financial records and supporting audit requirements.

- Manage payroll controls and governance, ensuring appropriate checks are completed throughout each payroll cycle and maintaining a strong audit trail.

- Drive continuous improvement and automation, identifying opportunities to reduce manual processes, improve controls and increase payroll efficiency.

- Act as SME for CloudPay and Workday payroll processes in Italy, supporting system enhancements, integrations, testing and payroll-related projects.

- Support Workday and payroll implementation/migration projects, including requirements gathering, testing, parallel runs and go-live activities.

- Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, proactively identifying risks and resolving payroll issues.

- Share knowledge and best practice with colleagues across the wider Payroll team, supporting a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence.

- Support regional and global payroll initiatives, ensuring Italy remains aligned with Deliveroo’s wider payroll strategy and operating model.

Requirements

- 3+ years of progressive payroll experience, including significant experience managing Italian payroll and statutory compliance.

- Strong technical knowledge of Italian payroll legislation, employment taxation, social security and statutory requirements.

- Experience managing or overseeing outsourced payroll providers, ideally within a multinational or international organisation.

- Experience with Workday and/or CloudPay is preferred but not essential.

- Proven ability to manage the full payroll lifecycle, including payroll inputs, validation, reconciliation, sign-off and statutory reporting.

- Strong understanding of payroll controls, governance, audit requirements and data integrity.

postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash’s current and future products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Principal Researcher to be a strategic research leader for EMEA, shaping what DoorDash builds next. You’ll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You’ll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You’ll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.

What You’ll Be Doing

Shape Product Strategy: Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You’ll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.

Detect New Opportunities: Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You’ll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.

Lead Mixed-Methods Research: Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You’ll triangulate across sources so the “what,” the “how much,” and the “why” tell one coherent story.

Partner with Data Science and Experimentation: Work closely with data science and analytics to connect qualitative insight to A/B test design, metrics, and product outcomes, and to explain the “why” behind results. You’ll help teams learn from what worked, what didn’t, and what to test next.

Apply AI to the Research Craft: Use AI tools and LLMs in your daily workflow for synthesis, analysis, survey and discussion guide design, and scaling qualitative depth, and design human-in-the-loop checks that catch confident but wrong outputs. You’ll help the team identify where AI accelerates research and where it should not be trusted, and contribute to shared prompts, workflows, and standards. You’ll also study how people experience AI-powered features across DoorDash’s products.

Influence and Communicate: Tell compelling, decision-ready stories that move partners from insight to action. You’ll adapt depth and format to the moment, from a fast directional read that unblocks a team this week to a foundational body of work that anchors a multi-year strategy, and you’ll follow through to see that findings change what gets built.

Lead Through Others: Serve as a thought partner and mentor to researchers across levels, review and elevate research quality, and help partners run good research on their own where that makes sense. You’ll help set the team’s research agenda, methods, and standards, and contribute to hiring and growing the team.

Operate Across Brands and Regions: Bring a global lens to your work, partnering across brands, markets, and cultures and adapting approaches to local context so that insights scale beyond a single market.

What We’re Looking For

- 10+ years of experience in user, market, or product research at a technology company (or equivalent depth), with a track record of leading ambiguous, high-visibility work at staff level or above

- Demonstrated impact on product strategy: examples where your research changed a roadmap, unlocked a new product or line of business, or redirected significant investment

- Proven ability to detect and shape new product or growth opportunities, from early signal through validated concept

- Expert command of both qualitative and quantitative methods, including interviews, ethnography, and usability testing as well as survey design, statistical analysis, and experimentation. Working knowledge of SQL, R, or Python for pulling and analyzing your own data is a plus

- Hands-on experience using AI and LLMs in research (for example, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, or scaling qualitative work), with sound instincts about where they help and where they mislead. Experience researching AI-powered products is a plus

- Experience in consumer, two-sided or multi-sided marketplace, logistics, commerce, or local services contexts is a plus

- Exceptional storytelling and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority and build trust across product, design, engineering, data science, and business teams

- A bias for speed and pragmatism: comfortable delivering directional insight quickly while knowing when a decision calls for deeper rigor

- Experience mentoring or coaching researchers and raising the quality of a research practice

- Advanced degree in HCI, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Economics, Statistics, Survey Methodology, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience

Deliveroo is a multi-award winning, international food business and one of the most successful recent technology companies to come out of the UK. We are on a mission to transform the way customers eat, just as Airbnb has for travel and Amazon has for e-commerce. Our aim is to bring great food to customers as fast as possible and in less than 30 minutes. Whether you want Pad Thai in the evening, a salad at lunch or forgot some key grocery items, we’ve got it covered.

The Small Medium Business (SMB) teams are responsible for Deliveroo’s relationships with thousands of independent restaurant and retail partners that operate on the Deliveroo marketplace in a number of markets across Europe, ensuring that they continue to grow and operate efficiently. The Sales team is the start of our funnel, consisting of inbound and outbound teams for all of Deliveroo’s EU markets (UK, Ireland, France, Italy and Belgium), across the restaurant, grocery and retail verticals.

- Guide daily activities across operational functions, ensuring quality and quantity of sales volume, adherence to performance targets, and seamless cross-team collaboration

- Championing change and leading on identifying new ways of working in collaboration with other Deliveroo functions to ensure we have the right tools and content to support our agents in acquiring new partners

- Partnering with the central teams to build robust plans that support driving change in the hub; through better engagement, improved efficiencies or increased capabilities.

- Collaborate with Learning and Development to ensure content of training materials and programmes is of maximum value to staff

This is a fast-paced role which will require an individual that can balance a number of competing priorities whilst remaining focused on core performance indicators. postings.description:

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Team

Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you’ll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. 

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You’ll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.

About The Logistics Team

Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.

These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.

It’s an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team’s work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.

What You’ll Be Doing 

You’ll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You’ll:

- Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.

- Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.

- Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.

- Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.

- Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.

- Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring:

- A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas.

- Experience setting analytical strategy and allocating people and effort across competing priorities, with clear evidence of product, operational or commercial impact.

- Strong technical foundations in experimentation, causal inference and statistical analysis, with the judgement to select appropriate methods, challenge conclusions and coach experienced practitioners.

- The ability to reason about interconnected systems and trade-offs, including how an intervention in one part of a marketplace can affect outcomes elsewhere.

- Experience influencing senior cross-functional leaders, aligning teams around shared goals and turning complex evidence into clear, actionable recommendations.

- A thoughtful approach to building teams: hiring, coaching, managing performance and developing future technical and people leaders.

- Comfort creating structure in ambiguous environments, making pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and adapting as new evidence emerges.

Experience developing other people managers would be particularly valuable. Experience in marketplaces, logistics, mobility, pricing, incentives or other operationally complex businesses is helpful, but not essential. We also value leaders who can bring relevant approaches from other domains.

postings.description:

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

We are looking for a decisive, operational leader to serve as Senior Manager, Global Command Centre. In this high-visibility role, you will own the real-time operational heartbeat of our customer support network across EMEA, leading a team of Command Centre analysts to protect service levels, optimize live capacity, and ensure seamless customer experiences across multiple markets and languages.

Beyond day-to-day real-time management, you will act as the single-threaded leader for major incident management. When operational disruptions, platform outages, or unexpected volume spikes occur, you own the end-to-end response, from opening the incident bridge and orchestrating cross-functional triage to leading executive communications, deploying customer-facing responses, driving resolution, and enforcing rigorous post-mortem governance.

What You Will Do

Real-Time Management (RTM) & EMEA Service Delivery

- Own Intraday Performance: Lead real-time monitoring and intraday management across all EMEA support channels (chat, voice, email, and automated workflows), balancing speed, quality, and efficiency against SLA and contact resolution targets.

- Dynamic Resource Allocation: Direct live skilling, queue routing, overtime/VTO triggers, and interval-level adjustments across internal teams and BPO partners to mitigate shrinkage, forecast variance, and peak-hour volatility.

- Proactive Anomaly Detection: Establish real-time alerting and operational dashboards to spot emerging friction points (e.g., localized delivery delays, payment failures, or broken self-service flows) before they escalate into major backlogs.

- Leadership Alerting and Real-Time Decision Making: Establish proactive leadership alerts and real-time performance reporting to provide immediate visibility into operational risks, emerging trends, and opportunities requiring intervention. Translate insights into swift execution across teams to protect service levels and improve customer experience.

End-to-End Incident Management

- Single-Threaded Incident Command: Serve as the primary Incident Commander for customer-impacting events. Open and run the live incident bridge, establish clear roles, maintain operational tempo, and drive alignment across Support, Engineering, Product, Logistics/Operations, and BPO leads.

- Customer Response Execution: Own the customer-facing crisis playbook—rapidly deploying targeted in-app messaging, IVR updates, help-centre banners, and agent response macros to deflect avoidable contacts and keep customers informed.

- Executive Communications: Translate fast-moving, technical, and operational ambiguity into crisp, structured, real-time updates for senior leadership, quantifying customer impact, operational mitigation steps, and estimated time to resolution (ETR).

- Closure & Post-Mortem Governance: Lead formal incident closure and blameless post-mortem reviews. Ensure root causes are documented, systemic preventative actions are assigned to owners with firm deadlines, and playbooks are updated to prevent repeat incidents.

Team Leadership & Operational Strategy

- Lead & Scale the Team: Manage, coach, and develop a team of Command Centre and Real-Time Analysts operating across extended EMEA hours, fostering a culture of calm urgency, analytical rigor, and operational ownership.

- Standardize Global Playbooks: Partner with Workforce Management (WFM), Automation, and Global Command Centre peers in other regions to standardize incident severity frameworks, escalation matrices, and follow-the-sun handoff protocols.

What We Are Looking For

- Experience: 7+ years of experience in Workforce Management, Real-Time Operations, Mission Control, or Technical/Customer Support Operations, including 3+ years directly managing and developing teams.

- High-Velocity Domain Background: Proven track record in a fast-paced, real-time consumer environment (e.g., on-demand delivery, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, or telecom) managing complex, multi-market, and multi-language EMEA operations.

- Incident Command Mastery: Extensive hands-on experience leading Major Incident Management (ITIL or equivalent frameworks). You remain calm under pressure, bring structure to chaos, and hold cross-functional stakeholders accountable without formal authority.

- Executive Presence & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of tailoring updates seamlessly from front-line BPO floor leads to C-level executives during high-severity events.

- Analytical & Tooling Fluency: Strong command of real-time telemetry, WFM software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Assembled), CRM/ticketing ecosystems (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce), incident tooling (e.g., PagerDuty, Jira, Slack), and BI/SQL for rapid root-cause diagnostics.

postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

Team Overview

You'll join our Integrated Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Integrated Marketing. The team leads Deliveroo's biggest multi-market marketing moments, including seasonal occasions (such as Christmas and Black Friday), cultural moments (such as the World Cup) and brand campaigns. We take each from global strategy through to local activation. You'll work in a cross-functional model alongside functional teams (media, creative, social, performance) and market teams, acting as the strategic lead and single point of accountability for each project. We value ownership, pace and thoughtful decision-making.

Role Overview

This is a strategy and delivery role, not a creative or agency-facing one. You'll own major global marketing initiatives from the first business brief through launch and post-campaign review, bringing together functional teams and local markets to deliver against a shared plan. Much of the role is project leadership: aligning up large groups of stakeholders, driving timelines, and securing sign-off from senior leaders. You'll make sound judgement calls when the brief is unclear, and you'll work through influence rather than direct line management.

Ownership & Delivery

- Write the business brief that sets the objectives, strategy, budget and market approach for a global initiative, and secure senior sign-off.

- Own each initiative end to end, from brief through launch to post-campaign analysis and learnings.

- Define success measures up front and report on impact.

- Keep the wider commercial and strategic picture in view, and contribute beyond your immediate remit.

Project leadership and delivery 

- Lead and orchestrate large cross-functional working groups across functional teams and local markets, setting timelines, running regular check-ins and holding people accountable.

- Plan and track milestones, dependencies and risks, and escalate early.

- Manage the budget for your projects and keep track of local spend.

- Prioritise across competing demands, knowing when to say no, delegate or escalate.

Strategy & Problem Solving

- Take a structured approach to ambiguous problems, gathering the right data and perspectives to land on workable, well-reasoned solutions.

- Apply market and industry knowledge to your decisions, and consider the longer-term strategic implications of your work.

- Contribute your expertise to discussions beyond your immediate remit, helping the wider team see the bigger picture

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

- Build trust and buy-in across functions, local markets and senior leaders whose priorities may differ.

- Present and defend recommendations with senior stakeholders, and adapt your message to the audience.

- Work consultatively with creative and media teams. You'll give input and feedback but not brief agencies directly.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

- 8+ years of progressive experience in marketing, ideally within a high-growth, consumer-facing or multi-category international business.

postings.title: Senior Payroll Analyst
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Analyst to join our Global Payroll team and play a key role in the delivery and continuous improvement of payroll across our international markets.

This is a senior operational role with responsibility for overseeing payroll activity across multiple countries. You will bring strong payroll expertise, sound judgement and a proactive approach to ensure employees are paid accurately, on time and in compliance with local legislation.

Working closely with the Payroll Team, internal HR and People teams, Finance, Tax and external payroll providers, you will take ownership of complex payroll activities, provide subject-matter expertise and act as a key escalation point for payroll issues.

The role will also provide opportunities to support international payroll projects, process improvements, system implementations and automation, helping Deliveroo build a scalable and efficient global payroll operation.

What you’ll be doing

- Take ownership of the end-to-end payroll delivery for assigned international entities.

- Partner with local HR, People Operations, Finance and Tax teams to ensure payroll inputs are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines.

- Review, validate and approve payroll inputs and outputs, identifying discrepancies, trends and potential risks before payroll is finalised.

- Apply a strong understanding of legislation across multiple jurisdictions, statutory requirements and payroll practices, ensuring processes remain compliant and appropriately controlled.

- Work closely with external payroll providers, holding them accountable for accuracy, timeliness, compliance and service delivery.

- Act as a senior escalation point for complex employee and stakeholder payroll queries, providing clear guidance and appropriate resolutions.

- Perform and oversee payroll reconciliations, payment validation and statutory submissions, ensuring appropriate controls are completed and documented.

- Analyse payroll data and reporting to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.

- Maintain strong payroll governance and documentation, ensuring processes, controls and procedures are consistently followed.

- Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate payroll processes, reducing manual intervention and operational risk.

- Support and lead payroll-related projects, including system implementations, payroll migrations, integrations, process changes and new entity onboarding.

- Partner with Technology and payroll vendors to troubleshoot system and integration issues and support effective resolution.

- Contribute to the development of payroll policies, procedures, controls and best practices across international markets.

- Share knowledge and provide guidance to Payroll Analysts and other team members, helping to build capability and consistency across the wider team.

- Stay up to date with changes to payroll legislation and communicate relevant impacts to internal stakeholders and payroll providers.

- Support the Payroll Lead with wider global payroll initiatives and deputise where required.

What you’ll bring

- Significant experience working in a payroll analyst or senior payroll position, ideally within a complex, international organisation.

- Strong hands-on experience of international payroll, with experience of Italy and/or France payroll highly desirable.

- Good working knowledge of Italian and/or French payroll legislation, statutory requirements and payroll processes is preferable.

- Experience managing payroll across multiple countries and working with third-party payroll providers.

- Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, payments, statutory reporting and compliance.

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate payroll data, identify discrepancies and understand the root cause of issues.

As we add new products, geographies, ways for Consumers, Merchants and Couriers to engage, we’re expanding and enhancing our fraud capabilities to be best in the industry at keeping our platform safe and trustworthy. postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Go / Kotlin & React)

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

- Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.

- Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

- Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.

- Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.

- Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.

- Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.

- Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.

- Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

How We Work

- Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.

- Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.

- Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

- Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

- An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

- Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.

- Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.

- Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

- Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.

- The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.

- Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

- Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.

- Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.

- Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.

- Integrations with external business systems.

- Kafka or other streaming technologies.

- Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform

About the Team

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

About the Role

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems and pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- 

Lead the design of infrastructure that helps teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

- 

Own and evolve our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

- 

Architect scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

- 

Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

- 

Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

- 

Partner closely with — and raise the technical bar for — ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

- 

Set technical direction for the future of the company's centralised GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimisation, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation.

We’re excited about you because…

- 

BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent

- 

5+ years of industry experience in software engineering

- 

Deep backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems.

- 

Track record of designing and owning production services, APIs, data pipelines, or ML infrastructure at scale.

- 

Experience operating systems in production, including observability, debugging, reliability, incident response, and performance/cost optimization.

- 

Deep hands-on experience with LLM inference and/or fine-tuning of open-weight models in production — serving (latency, throughput, batching, autoscaling, GPU utilization) and/or fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA).

- 

Demonstrated technical leadership: leading design across ambiguous, fast-moving technical areas, mentoring engineers, and turning customer use cases into reusable platform capabilities

Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

Experience with LLM inference engines and serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) in production

- 

Experience with distributed/multi-node fine-tuning and training pipelines (SFT, DPO/RLHF, LoRA), including data preparation and evaluation

- 

GPU performance work — multi-node/distributed inference, KV-cache/memory optimisation, quantisation (FP8/INT8/AWQ/GPTQ), or cold-start/throughput tuning

- 

Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), GPUs, serverless/elastic GPU platforms (e.g., Modal), or high-throughput batch systems

Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, vendor abstraction, or cost attribution

-

postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Team

At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It’s no simple task, but it wouldn’t be interesting if it was!

About the Role

Money is DoorDash’s organisation responsible for the financial products and infrastructure that enable transactions across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo. The domain owns how consumers pay, how merchants and couriers are paid, and how money is recorded, reconciled and reported, covering payment processing, payment methods, payouts, invoicing, financial ledgers and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help scale Money Domain. You will lead important engineering wide initiatives across Invoicing Platform, Payment Instruments, amongst others; working with Engineering, Product, Operations, and business leaders to deliver dependable, scalable Money capabilities for the business. Programs will span backend services, partner and merchant integrations, and regulatory / compliance products. They require strong technical judgment, cross organisational coordination, stakeholder management, and ownership of results.

You will report into the centralised global Technical Program Management team in Engineering, through a manager based in London. This is a hybrid role based in our London office in Cannon Street.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Drive Money Domain’s Most Strategic Programs - You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy & Operations, and cross-functional teams to turn Money Domain’s strategy into executable technical programs. 

- Lead Complex Cross-Organization Execution — Money Domain interacts with capabilities across consumer, merchant, courier, order and enterprise domains, payment processing, payouts, fraud and risk, regulatory compliance, accounting, financial data and platform infrastructure. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious.

- Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking - You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, integrations, data flows, and operational systems behind Money Domain (Financial Systems). You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect end-to-end consumer, rider/ courier, and merchant experiences, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs.

- Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action - Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind.

- Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes - You will understand the merchant, partner, customer, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution. 

We're excited about you because…

- You’re experienced in working with engineering teams on large-scale distributed systems and/or b2b products. You can speak to system architecture, scalability and reliability decisions, and design trade offs.

- You’re a strong leader with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organizations, bridge gaps between teams, and successfully influence without authority.

- You have strong ownership, urgency, and drive. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to understand and drive your programs.

- You have excellent written & verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus. You can convey concepts and considerations to non-experts and experts alike.

- You’ve engaged with Engineering teams on product & platform development with a thorough understanding of software development processes and project planning.

- You are pragmatic and detailed in your approach and focus on progress, not perfection.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree with experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or other related discipline.

- 5+ years recent experience as a Technical Programme Manager at a technology/ FinTech company, in Financial Systems.

- Experience with regulatory compliance in Financial Systems, e.g. SOX, PSD2, or equivalent would be an advantage.

- Experience in large-scale distributed systems and system architecture.

- Experience working directly with engineering teams on product development, with a thorough understanding of software development processes, system architecture, and scalability trade-offs.

- Project planning and execution skills that include reviewing technical design documents, estimating, and scheduling.

We’re looking for an Emirati UAE Site Operations Associate to join our Deliveroo Dubai HQ team. In this role, you’ll help us: Support role for the 3P site operations team. You keep third-party sites in a healthy day-to-day state, and you keep the team’s weekly rhythm running behind that.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Supporting Non Picker 3P site operations - Retail & Grocery operations team. On a set cycle you work through partner menus and admin pages, spot opening-hours problems, item unavailability, and live-order issues, and troubleshoot or coordinate with the team to resolve them. Alongside that you look after routine admin: report pulling, live ops support, key event ops support

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

Site checks

- Cycle through partner menus and admin pages on a set rota, covering the sites and brands the team is responsible for.

- Check opening hours against the agreed schedule. Flag sites that are closed when they should be open, or showing the wrong hours.

- Check item and menu availability. Flag items, categories, or whole menus that are unavailable without a known reason, and note how widespread the issue is.

- Watch live orders during key events. Flag orders that are stuck, late to be accepted, or piling up at a site.

- Log/flag technical issues and troubleshoot / work with the teams to resolve them

- Re-check after a fix is claimed, and close the item only when the menu, hours, or order state actually looks right.

- Escalate anything that is affecting live orders, or anything you cannot classify from the checklist, to the lead straight away.

Weekly data and reporting

- Pull the agreed Looker reports on a set schedule and drop them into the team’s working files.

- Update weekly trackers with the latest numbers, using the existing templates and checks.

- Flag missing data, broken filters, or numbers that do not match the usual pack, and raise them before the review.

- Keep a log of what was refreshed, when, and from which report.

Decks and reviews

- Build first drafts of weekly and monthly decks from the updated data and a standard outline.

- Drop in charts, tables, and commentary placeholders so the lead can add the narrative.

Admin and coordination

- Attend meets and align on priority partners and work for the week

- Keep shared drives, trackers, and inboxes tidy so anyone on the team can find the current file.

- Keep logs of resolved issues and pending ones

Team support

- Take well-defined tasks from the lead and site operations teammates and close them on time.

- Escalate anything unclear, live, or outside the usual process rather than deciding it yourself.

postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Software Engineers, Subscriptions - Backend

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, one of the largest online food ordering and delivery platforms in the world. As part of this role, you'll join one of our Subscriptions teams in London, focused on the core proposition and working across our three subscription programmes - DashPass, Deliveroo Plus, and Wolt+. You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI.

💡 Why Subscriptions? 

- An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship.

- Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale.

- Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity.

- A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously.

🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here

We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who:

- Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR.

- Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own?

- Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team.

- Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype.

If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in.

🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles

- Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.

- Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them.

- Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do.

- Collaborative instincts - the Subscriptions domain sits at the intersection of consumer mobile, web, backend, and data. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception.

🙌 About You 

- You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends.

- What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work.

- You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through.

🌍 Where You'll Work 

These roles are based in our tech hub in London.

postings.description:

About the Company

Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company’s three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash’s Traffic platform. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. Our team owns the infrastructure that carries every request into and through that platform: the edge, where we manage Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, rate limiting, bot mitigation) and the ingress systems for external traffic, and service-to-service (S2S) communication, where we run the service mesh and the authentication that secures calls between thousands of services across multiple regions.

You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. It includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency-sensitive workloads at DoorDash, from the first byte at the edge to the last hop between services.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the EU-Traffic Team within the Infrastructure organization. This role is hybrid working from London.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Design and build large-scale distributed systems that are high RPS and latency sensitive

- Troubleshoot, debug, and fix issues that affect production and maintain our SLAs

- Work collaboratively with other platform and product engineers to deliver on feature requests and solve their problems

- Find ways to improve the team’s productivity and operational capabilities through the use of automation, AI tools, and other avenues

- Participate in a shared on-call rotation and help lead production investigations and incidents, with support from teammates

- Mentor and learn from teammates through design reviews, pairing, and incident reviews

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer in infrastructure, networking, or platform engineering/SRE

- Experience operating edge technologies at scale, such as CDN, WAF, proxy layers, and DNS

- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals like TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTP/2, gRPC, Load Balancing

- Background working on and debugging high-QPS or latency-sensitive systems

- You’re curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in ambiguity

Bonus points if you…

- Experience with programming languages like Go, C++, Python or Rust

- Experience with AWS, especially with networking primitives like LBs, Privatelink, etc. and Kubernetes or other container management tool

- Experience with service mesh technologies such as Envoy, Istio or Linkerd

- Familiarity with xDS or control plane architectures

- Experience building RPC frameworks or client-side networking libraries

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling like Terraform

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the role

- 

Hybrid (3 days per week in the London office required)

- 

Individual contributor role

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

Core responsibilities

- 

Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

- 

Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

- 

Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

- 

Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.

What you’ll be doing

- 

Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys to identify where fraud or abuse risk may arise, using data, operational knowledge and structured, hypothesis-led analysis.

- 

Develop analytical approaches and key metrics to identify patterns, quantify impact, assess detection signals and measure the effectiveness of policy interventions over time.

- 

Define new policies, or revise existing ones, in response to identified risks that may negatively affect customers, couriers/riders, the platform or the wider business.

- 

Conduct impact and risk assessments, framing clear options and recommendations that consider effectiveness, operational feasibility, cost, legal and regulatory requirements, and potential unintended consequences.

- 

Partner closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science, Trust and Operations teams to shape business requirements, implement agreed responses and resolve complex trade-offs.

- 

Establish effective ways of working across Wolt and Deliveroo so that emerging trends, priority risks and lessons from policy performance are identified early and shared with relevant stakeholders.

- 

Lead cross-functional delivery from problem identification through to implementation, reporting and post-launch monitoring, adapting the approach as new evidence emerges.

What we’re looking for

- 

6+ years’ experience in fraud, risk, compliance, policy, operations, consulting or a related field.

- 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to combine data, operational context and judgement to identify root causes and prioritise action.

- 

Experience translating complex or ambiguous risk issues into practical policies, recommendations and implementation plans.

- 

Experience navigating complex legal and regulatory landscapes and working constructively with Legal and Public Policy stakeholders.

- 

Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders and challenge constructively when needed.

- 

Strong project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritise effectively and drive delivery in a fast-paced environment.

- 

Comfortable using AI-enabled tools appropriately to support analysis, hypothesis generation and problem solving.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
