postings.title: Staff Conversation Designer (Support)
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Staff Conversation Designer to join in London and set the design direction for AI-powered support across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You'll bring a strong AI fluency, technical practice, and editorial point of view to build and shape conversations powered by our LLM models: deciding what a conversation needs to say, what to leave out and how to make each exchange clear, useful, and worthy of people's trust.

You'll shape the personality, voice, tone and experience principles that express our brands, local language and support philosophy. You will craft conversation specs, prompts, and evals, annotate data, and co-build the tools and harness that drives our experience. Success means fewer avoidable problems, better resolutions when help is needed, and stronger design practices that help teams deliver those outcomes consistently.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Set support conversation strategy across support journeys, connecting what people need in the moment, what the business can promise, and what operations can actually do. Influence roadmaps with Product, Engineering and Operations, deciding where to invest, what to sequence first and how to balance quality, speed and impact.

- Design and maintain conversation flows. Lead proactive guidance, chat and voice experiences from definition through launch, anticipating needs to prevent or resolve problems before people ask for help. Create and maintain multi-turn conversation specs covering context, interruptions, changing intent, clarification, error recovery, fallback paths and human handoffs without repetition.

- Prototype new conversational experiences. Invent and test new conversational patterns, interaction paradigms, personas, and support experiences. Use LLMs and code to explore how people could ask for help, act on options and move between chat, voice and other interfaces. Work with Engineering to shape the information, actions, and human judgement these experiences need, using working prototypes and user feedback to decide what to pursue.

- Shape voice, tone and behaviour. Set the editorial direction for support conversations across brands, markets and modalities. Write and iterate on system prompts and persona definitions that express this direction through model behaviour. Make deliberate choices about wording, pacing and tone, adapting to local voices, policies and access needs while keeping conversations useful and promises accurate.

- Build evaluation datasets and testing plans. Establish how teams evaluate conversation quality before and after launch. Create evaluation datasets, testing plans and scoring rubrics to test conversation flows and model behaviour. Define annotation guidelines and annotate conversations for evaluation and model training, calibrating judgments so teams assess quality consistently. Combine these evaluations with research, performance data and reviews of hundreds of transcripts to improve accuracy, resolution quality and customer effort, and influence what the team prioritises.

- Design conversational safeguards. Identify conversational risks and define, implement and test guardrails. Address hallucinations, harmful or biased responses, and requests outside the service’s scope. Define how conversations protect sensitive information, stay within the system’s authority to act, and acknowledge uncertainty or seek human judgement.

- Raise conversation design capability. Help the wider Studio develop technical fluency and conversational judgement through mentorship, education and shared tools. Build reusable prompt guidance, evaluation tools and working practices with design and cross-functional peers, and lead their adoption across teams to improve conversation quality and inform product priorities.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

- Work samples. Work samples showing strong editorial and conversational judgement, whether through conversational systems, content programmes or shipped products. Show your personal contribution, the direction you set, alternatives you explored and evidence of improved outcomes. We welcome different formats that make your thinking, execution and influence clear.

- Strategic leadership. Experience setting direction across teams and influencing product priorities, with examples of resolving ambiguity and making trade-offs between user needs, commercial goals and technical constraints.

- Editorial judgement. A strong editorial point of view, backed by excellent writing and editing. You can explain why a conversation needs a particular message, sequence or tone, cut what gets in the way and give others specific feedback that improves the work. Your background may be in editorial, content design, linguistics, product design or another discipline; what matters is how you apply that judgement to interactive experiences.

- Hands-on AI practice. Practical fluency with LLMs and code, demonstrated through working AI prototypes and direct investigation of model behaviour. You can distinguish conversational problems from limitations in data, tools or the wider system.

- Service design judgement. The ability to connect individual conversations to the wider service, including user intent, context, available actions and agent workflows. Your decisions account for accessibility, localisation, privacy and situations that need human intervention.

- Evaluation and training experience. Experience developing conversation evaluations and annotating model-training data, with evidence of how qualitative and quantitative findings improved model behaviour and informed product decisions.

- Impact beyond your own work. A track record of improving other teams’ design quality through mentorship, critique and shared tools or practices they’ve adopted.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

postings.title: Staff Motion Designer- Studio Central
postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Role

At DoorDash we are redefining what it means to be a designer. We are building toward a team of makers, builders, and doers. Between 2005 and 2015, "web designer" became "product designer" and the scope widened. The same shift is happening now, as LLMs expand that scope again, toward strategy on one end and direct execution on the other. As a Staff Motion Designer, you will lead this shift within your discipline: not just practicing build-first motion design, but multiplying it through the systems and people around you.

You'll join Studio Central, a net-new Product Design team sitting at the intersection of product, brand, and innovation. Studio Central is a global team within Studio, DoorDash's Product Design organization, supporting DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms. We own how brand shows up in the product experience, partnering closely with Marketing and Product teams to shape cohesive, high-quality work and to help define the foundations, vision, and future state of design across our portfolio. Our work spans major brand moments, merchandising, and the systems that connect it all.

There's no finished playbook here, and that's intentional. We're looking for someone who thrives in building structure from scratch: getting our design standards documented, adopted, and evolving across every brand and surface, and keeping work moving from brief to delivery across in-house teams, agencies, and cross-functional partners in Product Design, Marketing, and Engineering. You'll help build Studio Central's operating model as we go, setting the standard for how a distributed design organization stays aligned as it scales, and ensuring all motion design outputs are at the highest craft bar.

We operate in a hybrid working model, 1-2 days out of one of our Design Hubs, the rest working from home.

Your primary impact is to help build a future where motion is a primary discipline within Studio, not a downstream execution step: you'll define the principles, build the guidelines that follow from them, and then do the harder work of advocating for and influencing their adoption across every brand and surface, in-house and agency alike. Your secondary impact is revenue: Studio Central is accountable for how brand shows up inside the product experience, and faster, more consistent brand-to-product translation means more campaigns, seasonal moments, and merchandising pushes ship at a bar that raises craft and expression across DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms as a whole.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

- 

Define the point of view on how branded moments should move and behave across the products, elevating the craft and expression throughout customers, dashers and merchant experiences

- 

Bring clarity to a genuinely undefined space: today there's no single owner for how brand-in-product motion gets made, reviewed, or shipped, across DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms. You'll build the principles, the rituals and process, as well as define the point of view on what "good" looks like, while staying productive inside whatever structure exists on a given day

- 

Take key brand moments from concept through execution: collaborate with visual designers on early direction to build animatics through production-ready, code-shippable motion (Lottie/dotLottie, CSS/JS animation, native transitions, etc.) that sets the craft standard for the team

- 

Build reusable motion systems, an expression framework, animated component libraries, AI-assisted motion tooling, that let designers across every brand ship strong motion without needing you in the room every time

- 

Build trusted relationships across Product Design teams, including Consumer, Ads & Promo, Dasher, Merchant and New Verticals, as well as the creative studio in Marketing and our agency partners, using working prototypes rather than decks to make the case for what a brand moment should look like in-product

- 

Help define what motion craft means at DoorDash as the team grows: the crits, guidelines, and onboarding that let this capability scale past a single person

We're excited about you because...

- 

Your portfolio shows motion and visual craft at a systems level, not just one-off animations, but frameworks or guidelines that scaled across surfaces, teams, or products

- 

You move fluidly between art direction and execution: you prototype in tools like After Effects, Lottie, or Rive, and increasingly ship production motion directly in code

- 

You've built something from a blank page before and default to proposing a framework rather than waiting for a brief that doesn't exist yet

- 

You treat a new tool or technique as an experiment worth running, not a decision you need to get right the first time, you'll ship a handful of rough attempts in something you picked up last week before you'd sit through a training on it

- 

You navigate ambiguous, cross-team problems and create clarity through shipped work, not slide decks

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

We sit within the Public Policy function and work closely with other teams on a daily basis.

We're hiring a Strategy Lead, Sustainable Delivery to help shape our global approach to sustainable delivery and lead its execution. postings.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
About the Role

- 

Hybrid (3 days per week in the London office required)

- 

Individual contributor role

Fraud is constantly evolving. As our business grows, so do the ways bad actors seek to exploit our products, promotions, and operations.

As the Senior Strategy & Operations Manager for Emerging Fraud & Abuse, you'll lead the discovery, investigation, and mitigation of new and evolving abuse vectors across our platform. Your mission is to identify risks before they become systemic, working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Legal, and Policy to design scalable solutions that protect our customers, partners, and business.

This isn't a role focused on running existing fraud programmes. It's about identifying what's next.

You'll combine deep analytical thinking with strategic problem solving to uncover emerging threats, quantify business impact, influence product strategy, and build new controls that keep us ahead of increasingly sophisticated fraudsters.

If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, following the data, and building solutions where no playbook exists, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

- 

Identify Emerging Abuse

- 

Proactively identify new fraud patterns, abuse trends, and vulnerabilities across our products, customer journeys, and operational processes.

- 

Investigate anomalies, understand attacker behaviours, and translate observations into actionable mitigation strategies.

- 

Continuously scan for evolving risks, whether driven by organised fraud, policy loopholes, technological change, or new product launches.

- 

Build the Strategy

- 

Define the roadmap for emerging fraud prevention across the business.

- 

Prioritise risks based on customer impact, financial exposure, operational complexity, and strategic importance.

- 

Develop business cases that influence investment in tooling, automation, machine learning, and product improvements.

- 

Turn Insights into Action

- 

Lead complex investigations to understand how abuse occurs and where existing controls can be strengthened.

- 

Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to design scalable prevention mechanisms rather than tactical fixes.

- 

Establish metrics that measure both emerging risk and the effectiveness of mitigation strategies.

- 

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

- 

Act as the central point of coordination between Fraud, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Customer Operations, Legal, Finance, and Data Science.

- 

Influence roadmaps to ensure fraud prevention is embedded into product development from the earliest stages.

- 

Support major product launches by identifying potential abuse scenarios and recommending preventative controls.

- 

Build Organisational Capability

- 

Develop frameworks for identifying, prioritising, and responding to emerging threats.

- 

Improve how intelligence is shared across teams to ensure new attack patterns are detected and mitigated quickly.

- 

Help foster a culture of proactive fraud prevention across the organisation.

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys solving complex, high-impact business problems.

You'll bring:

- 

Experience investigating complex fraud, abuse, or operational risk problems

- 

Strong analytical skills with SQL and the ability to work comfortably with large datasets

- 

A structured approach to solving ambiguous problems with limited information

- 

Experience influencing Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams without direct authority

- 

The ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations

- 

Strong commercial judgement and an understanding of balancing customer experience with risk mitigation

Influence through evidence rather than hierarchy

Stay ahead of emerging technologies and evolving fraud techniques
